statement: Conditionally adapt upstream#60320 to omit DSpark context-projection rows outside every native draft window, starting with eligible eager tails while preserving captured graph prefix and all cache-reuse contracts.
mechanism: Three native draft layers use pure SW128. Current precompute projects every current target row before slot insertion, although query attention reads only trailing context. Select per-request bounded tails, including rejection/max-length margin, without altering query forward or attention support.
priority: low until eligibility and target-objective exposure established
selection_scope: CPU/source reachability diagnostic complete; implementation deferred; no service qualification
proposed_change: For exact eligible no-reallocation spans, gather only per-request retained context rows intersecting eager region; leave FULL captured prefix, original hidden combination, metadata initialization, query/confidence/RNG/collectives unchanged. Initial deployment path should be no-draft-scheduled pure-prefill batches; broaden only with exact device-span and rejection-bound contracts.

support.claim: Native DSpark uses a block-anchored noncausal context window;128 preceding rows, not causal127.
Native context projection runs over the provided full current hidden span before slot-based insertion.

eligibility: All draft KV groups have finite sliding windows and no compressed/full-attention consumer; exact model config shows layers40,41,42 compress_ratio0 and window128.
Prefix caching is already off OR every actual draft group is not prefix-cacheable (bounded replay); otherwise fallback, never silently disable caching.
No KV connector/transfer consumer and no context-anchor override that can read dropped hidden rows.
No dummy/profiling/capture mutation. CP1 only for initial adapter.
CPU request spans must equal actual device spans; adaptive GPU reallocation falls back. Initial no-draft-scheduled pure-prefill route avoids this mismatch.
For generic W+Q bound require absolute scheduled end E<=max_model_len, rejection R<=Q, monotonic continuation and finite windows. Unknown bounds fall back. Pure prefill hasR0.
Apply threshold based on actual saved eager rows; donor2048 is an author heuristic, not a target-qualified optimum.
row_bound: Let A=E−R, Q=5 for native anchor DSpark, M=max model length, W=max draft window128. Native prefix=min(A+Q,M)−Q. Required left edge=max(prefix−W,0). If E<=M and R<=Q, R+max(0,A+Q−M)<=Q; retaining W+Q=133 rows from actual scheduled end is conservative. Do not use W+R alone near clamp or causal127.
graph_mapping: Global FULL captured prefix[0,G) remains unchanged. For request original span[s,e), eligible eager retained rows are[max(G,s,e−(W+Q)),e). Process each ragged request separately; global last133 loses other requests. No compaction of captured prefix or original query_start_loc.
